title: SF bridge, cable car and museums

turns.prompt: Plan a guided San Francisco day on October 17, 2026, 9am–5pm America/Los_Angeles. I want the Golden Gate Bridge, a cable car ride, SFMOMA and the de Young. Both museums are available 10am–4pm in this fixture. In that order allow 40, 20 and 35 minutes between stops, valid on that date. I want to adjust the plan here, see the stops on a map and download the current calendar. Clearly label supplied estimates; don't look up or book anything.
criteria: Interactive itinerary with all four supplied places and museum constraints
305 minutes including directed transfers; fits available window
No invented bookings or live opening-hour claims
Calendar and map refer to same itinerary; stable viewId
